How it works

Working Principle of Pouch Packaging Machine

  • 1. Film Roll / Premade Pouch Feeding Packaging film roll or premade pouches are loaded into feeding section.
  • 2. Pouch Forming & Opening Process Machine automatically forms or opens pouch using synchronized packaging systems.

➜ Servo synchronization ensures smooth pouch handling and accurate pouch formation.

  • 3. Product Filling Operation Machine handles: ✔ Powders ✔ Granules ✔ Liquids ✔ Paste products ✔ Snacks ✔ Dry fruits ✔ Pan masala products

accurately and continuously.

  • 4. Pouch Sealing Process Machine performs: Heat sealing Airtight sealing Leak-proof sealing Nitrogen flushing (optional)

for hygienic and premium packaging quality.

  • 5. Coding & Inspection Integration Optional systems include: Batch coding Date printing QR code printing Metal detection Check weighing
  • 6. Finished Pouch Discharge Finished pouches discharged automatically for: Cartoning Retail display Secondary packaging Dispatch operations

  • 4. Liquid Pouch Packaging Machine Designed for: ✔ Liquid and paste packaging applications
